In most instances, it is caused or heedlessness or inadvertence, by which the negligent party is unaware of the results, which may follow from his act. Negligence is that, a breach of duty or lack of probable care in doing something. In short, it is want of attention and doing of something, which a prudent and reasonable man would not do. The burden is upon the petitioner to prove that, the accident occurred due to negligent driving of the driver of the Tipper Lorry bearing Reg. No. MP-04-HE-1839.
